name: Chat Composer
summary: An AI chat input card with a growing textarea, attach button, slot for tools such as a model picker, and a round send button that becomes stop while the assistant replies.
useWhen: A plain, solid AI chat input is needed with Enter to send and Shift+Enter for a new line
The send button must switch to stop while the assistant is replying
avoidWhen: The input needs effort levels, sparks, voice or command menus, where ai-chat/prompt-bar fits
A message box for a chat between people
